title: Global Gevrey Hypoellipticity of Involutive Systems on Non-Compact Manifolds
summary: We investigate the global Gevrey hypoellipticity of a class of first-order differential operators associated with tube-type involutive structures on $M\times\mathbb{T}^m$, where $M$ is a non-compact manifold diffeomorphic to the interior of a compact manifold with boundary and $\mathbb{T}^m$ is the $m$-dimensional torus. For $s>1$, we work in Gevrey classes of Roumieu and Beurling type.
